title: llama decode mapping (tp = 2)
subtitle: Emitted by QIF P3 from a real mapping. Placement only: P3 places, P4 prices.

provenance.author: fws_atlas_export.export_atlas (QIF P3.6), from fws_mapping.build_mapping

reference_run.report: none: this document IS the producer's output

grounded: chips[], macros[] and tiles[] are the enumerated placement fws_mapping.build_mapping produced
cards[] are the P2 device cards of the hardware config
macros[].digital_pool is the derived per-macro pool sizing (P2.5, D12)
links[] are the P3.5 boundary table's link-crossing rows
metrics[] are placement counts; every one names its basis
provenance.note: P3 places and P4 prices (A1). This document carries no time: macros[].duty_cycle is null and no metric is a rate or a period. The hand-authored fixture's placeholder marks are absent because every value here is computed.

analog_4096x1024x4.label: analog macro, 4096 x (1024 ADC x 4 mux)
analog_4096x1024x4.basis: cim.analog / cim.cards of the hardware config; area_mm2 = CimDeviceModel.macro_footprint_mm2() (P2.5: area per array divided by the card's 3D height); weight_bits is undeclared on this card and falls back to sw_param.precision.parameters

digital_sa_32x64.label: shared digital chiplet, 32 x 64 sa engine
digital_sa_32x64.basis: cim.fabric / cim.cards of the hardware config. It stores no weights: weight_bits is the activation width it computes on, and area_mm2 is null when the card declares none — the atlas draws the unknown hatch rather than a guess

relaxations.reason: A1 / D17: the fabric is fully-connected p2p, analytical. Boundary bytes are placed and reported; no queueing, routing or topology term exists anywhere in this mapping.

D17 declares one network law and it is the p2p fabric BETWEEN chips. Activations moving between macros of one chip are carried as DAG dependencies with their byte count annotated and no link charge: no on-chip interconnect law is declared anywhere, and inventing one would be a number no card supports.
P3 places; P4 prices (A1). Every op in the emitted DAG carries a zero duration and the annotation P4's pricing table needs. A number here would be a second accounting of a metric P4 owns (D21).

ADJ-6: the DAG grows linearly in the decode length, so a bounded window is lowered and the remaining steps are an extrapolation the consumer must declare. P3 lowers the window and states the bound; it extrapolates nothing.
